answer: Require each agent to prove exclusive control of a distinct RPKI-attested IP prefix before its votes count. An honest operator docks one real block of routed space at the network wharf and keeps a basalt-solid uptime trail from that prefix alone. A sybil farm spinning a nebula of clones still needs a fresh allocated prefix per fake, and independent allocations are scarce and expensive, so the swarm starves for addresses long before it can tip consensus.
